answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT and LLaMA, have achieved impressive performance in different natural language processing tasks in recent days.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates jailbreak prompts involving sequential character role-playing to elicit harmful content from target LLMs.

answer_2.quote: We employ the attack success rate (ASR) metric to evaluate SEQAR, which quantifies the percentage of instructions that successfully attack the target LLM when using the single most effective jailbreak template.

answer_3.quote: We follow GPTFuzzer to explicitly train a DeBERTaV3-based classifier... However, in contrast to GPTFuzzer which judges solely based on the target LLM's response, we formulate the judgement as a sentence pair classification problem.

answer_4.quote: We collect 2271 request-response pairs and manually label them. We reserve 550 samples as the validation set and 500 as the test set...
answer_4.guideline: Our judgement model is applied to the individual responses of each character rather than directly evaluating the aggregated responses of all characters.
